task: Finish PR #2232: Aegis Pilot: market research, and C5 operator decision as a signed ledger event
prompt:
Bring PR #2232 ("Aegis Pilot: market research, and C5 operator decision as a signed ledger event", branch claude/dws-iq7-aegis-research-lwqxgw) to mergeable. Do not change what the PR is for.
1) git fetch origin && git merge origin/main — resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent; regenerate lockfiles/generated files with the repo's tooling, never by hand.
2) gh pr checks 2232 and gh pr view 2232 --comments: fix every failing check and every review finding that is a real bug; for optional nits, fix only if trivial.
3) Run the checks CI would run for the changed files (npx tsc --noEmit, related vitest, prettier --check).
4) Commit and git push origin claude/dws-iq7-aegis-research-lwqxgw (a merge commit, never a rebase or force-push).
5) If something needs a human decision (content, pricing, policy), write it as a PR comment with gh pr comment and stop.

checks.name: origin/main is merged in
checks.run: git fetch -q origin main && (git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD || git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main)

checks.name: no failing PR checks (except the Copilot reviewer app, which fails on every PR)
checks.run: out=$(gh pr checks 2232 2>&1 | grep -v copilot-pull-request-reviewer); echo "$out" | tail -15; ! echo "$out" | grep -qiE '\bfail(ed|ure)?\b'

checks.name: GitHub sees it as mergeable or merged
checks.run: s=$(gh pr view 2232 --json state -q .state); echo "state=$s"; [ "$s" = MERGEABLE ] || [ "$s" = MERGED ]
